text: The bug is on lines 34–40: `line.split("=")` splits on every `=`, so `parts[1]` only contains the text up to the second `=`, and `.split("#")[0]` strips everything after a `#`. Fix: split only on the first `=` and keep the rest verbatim.

        result[section][key] = parts[1].split("#")[0].strip()

        result[section][key] = value.strip()
